description.p: Adds a button to the Nuxeo Web UI that opens the current document directly in Microsoft Word, Excel or PowerPoint, using the WebDAV protocol. Edits saved from the Office application are sent back to Nuxeo and update the document.
The button is only shown when the document has a main file whose mime type or file name matches a Microsoft Office format.
Self-contained: the plugin provides its own WebDAV endpoint and requires no other addon.
